note: Budget Intelligence crosswalk: how names in the City's business-case document are matched to the City's open budget data (2027-2030 Budget, nnnm-9sfh), and which Calgary Insight screens hold data on the same subject. Kept by hand; nothing in the City's documents is changed. A name with no entry is used exactly as printed.

Calgary Police Services.basis: The same body; the document prints the name with and without the final s.

Law, Legislative Services, & Security.basis: The same name with an extra comma.

People, Innovation & Collaboration Servi.basis: Different names in the two City sources; matched because all five business units the document lists under it (Information Technology, Human Resources, Marketing & Communications, Occupational Health & Safety, 311 & Insights) are the business units the open data lists under People & Corporate Services. An inference, not confirmed by the City.
People, Innovation & Collaboration Servi.label: People, Innovation & Collaboration Services

budget_departments_basis: The open data's own two columns (department and budget_department): six departments are reported under two budget departments.

Calgary Police Services.basis: The same body; printed with a final s.

Calgary Fire Department.basis: The same business unit under its longer name.

GM - Planning and Development.basis: The same office, printed in a shorter form.

Marketing & Communications.basis: The same business unit; the open data drops the final s.

Parks & Open Spaces.basis: The same name with an ampersand.

business_units_unmatched.Chief Operating Officer: The open data has two units, Chief Operating Office - City Services and Chief Operating Office - Water Services; the document does not say which, so it is not matched.

Explicit.basis: Printed cut short in two capital cases; grouped with the full wording.

Implicit.basis: Printed cut short in one capital case; grouped with the full wording.

service_areas.relationship: Topic link: the screen holds data on the same subject. No dollars are divided between places and no cause is claimed.

Roads & Pathways: pavement quality, the paving plan and 311 reports about roads, sidewalks and streetlights
Water Utilities: water main breaks, the age of water mains and sewer lines
how long sewer pipes last and how old Calgary's are
water rates in the household bill
Waste & Recycling: cart fees in the household bill
Transit: how near homes are to transit stops
Parks & Urban Forestry: how near homes are to parks and playgrounds
Recreation: how near homes are to recreation centres
Community & Culture: how near homes are to libraries
Police: performance, resources and the 2027 to 2030 budget request
Bylaw: open 311 requests by kind and age

departments_label: label: the name the centre shows in its own lists when the document's name and the open-data name are different names (not just different spellings). The document's name is kept.
